cohort_proposal.selection: Hash-fixed per scene, prefer distinct physical point paths before multiple expressions; deterministic collision/fallback counts retained.
cohort_proposal.exposure: Exploratory target VAL already research-exposed in R5/R7/R8; new source training excluded target platforms, not fresh target holdout.

normal_branch.identity: Fresh strictFP32 q0=original pure-text argmax; all11 arms fixed same actual source q0 in that process.
normal_branch.G: R8 signal and thresholds retained; only forced q0-containing group rather than reselection. Actual difference must be code-reviewed, not labeled identical R8 if gating changes.
normal_branch.size: All pseudo size weights zero; size prior from q0 unchanged.
normal_branch.controls: same final float32 pseudo for direct, true parameter SGD and exact output-space replay; 1/3 steps each source reset; no GT fields/classes/positive maps/identity in inputs.
normal_branch.primary: All160 samples per platform, native yaw0 selected IoU/strict Acc25/Acc50, center and size error after seal. No identity filtering for primary.
normal_branch.denominators: all / w_any / actual_float32_pseudo_nonzero / nonzero_parameter_update / common_eligible; all skips and failures explicit.

identity_diagnostic_postseal.inventory: Same metadata/frame target entries plus each entry others bbox; ground_info are expressions, not assumed unique or exhaustive objects. Transform every box to source frame before geometric dedup.
identity_diagnostic_postseal.dedup: Equivalent annotated boxes by center within1e-5m and independently computed boxIoU>1-1e-7; complete-link grouping, original references retained privately; class labels not used for grouping or target selection and semantic conflicts are not resolved by this geometric method.
identity_diagnostic_postseal.confirmation: q0 targetIoU>.25 and targetIoU-max(unique non-target IoU)>.1, target must be unique matched group. Empty other inventory and duplicate/class conflicts explicitly reported.
identity_diagnostic_postseal.name: annotated-spatially-confirmed, never exact semantic identity or exhaustive inventory proof
identity_diagnostic_postseal.limits: GT selection used only offline conditioning after normal seal; conditional results not primary method gains. fixed hash overlay subset validates physical plausibility without changing decisions.

GT_positive_control_branch.separation: Separate directory/run/release; normal complete seal precedes target injection. Replay same sealed normal forward cache/q0/features, verify head source weights and native FP32 replay; no fresh-process query-slot transfer. Isolated GTindex strict{id,target6_modelcoords}, no yaw/class/identity. Oracle/NOT_TTA flag mandatory; never fed to normal G.
targets: C: GT center with source size
S: source center with GT dimensions
GT_positive_control_branch.arms: direct target, same normalized SmoothL1 SGD1/3, one normalized-linear-L2 exact-fit step; each resets source, fixed q0.
GT_positive_control_branch.exact_fit: Loss 0.5*sum_j((prediction_j-target_j)^2 / (||h_block||^2+1)) on active rows; SGD lr1/no momentum/no decay/no clipping, center and size use own feature norms. Exact target in real arithmetic; float32 declared tolerance not bitexact claim.
GT_positive_control_branch.capacity_primary: Selected centerL2 / sizeL2 / coordinateLinf vs direct target, signed changes vs source, true gradients and center/size parameter changes, source restore; all-query spillover diagnostic only.
GT_positive_control_branch.yaw_boundary: Native yaw0 retained, so GT dimension replacement is not maximal-IoU oracle when GT yaw differs; no claim GTyaw or any substitution strictly maximizes IoU.
GT_positive_control_branch.failure_interpretation: GT fit succeeds but normal fails supports deficient signal/assignment rather than unreachable last-head coordinates; normal w_size0 cannot test size correction; same-SGD insufficient progress differs from exact-fit capacity.

statistics: Platform separately; 2Drone/3Quad scene means and paired descriptive scene resampling(seed901,2000draws), strict >.25/.5, signed tails atol1e-8 separate exact counts.
gates: Parent-specific CPU_SCORE_RELEASE required; check complete normal/source/program/checkpoint/manifest seals before loading any GT. GT positive branch additionally requires GT_INJECTION_RELEASE and explicit parent normal-seal binding. No GPU by evaluator.
